They went out at first light with the chain and the
poles. The boy walked ahead, testing the ground with a
willow switch, and where the switch sank he said cuidado
without turning round. By noon they had fixed forty-six
stations and lost one boot. The wind brought salt, and
under the salt the smell of something older, as if the
sea had left its cellar door open.

That night she inked the first sheet. She wrote Low
Harbor in the corner and under it, smaller, the date,
and then sat for a long while looking at the white part
of the paper, which was most of it.
